caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest seen from an angled front view. The chest is rectangular in shape and has a flat lid. Its surface is primarily brown with a wood grain texture. The front panel and side panels are decorated with painted motifs that include curving vine-like or scroll patterns in lighter colors, interspersed with stylized flowers in shades of yellow, orange, and red, as well as small birds painted in red. The decorative designs are framed by raised rectangular borders that also have painted embellishments in subdued tones such as blue and green. The central front panel has a keyhole, indicating that the chest can be locked. The chest sits directly on the ground with no visible feet or legs. The overall composition centers the chest against a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects present.
title: Painted Guilford Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
